prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone Minecraft mod logo, one square icon.
Primary request: Create an entirely original logo from scratch, without reference images or borrowing an existing mod identity.
Style/medium: polished low-poly voxel-inspired 3D emblem, broad crisp facets, strong silhouette, restrained detail, handcrafted game inventory illustration.
Composition/framing: one compact centered emblem in a square canvas, three-quarter view, the complete silhouette comfortably inside the frame, approximately 12 percent padding. Easy to recognize at 64 pixels.
Lighting/mood: carefully shaded sculptural objects, clear edges and readable depth, gentle highlights.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for later transparency extraction. The background must be the same exact color in every corner and all empty space.
Text: none; do not include words, letters, captions, labels, watermarks or mockup branding.
Constraints: only the requested emblem; no frame, no border, no badge disk, no scenery, no ground plane, no cast shadow onto the background, no reflections, no haze blending into the background. Do not use magenta or pink in the emblem. No input/reference images.
Subject: A distinctive squat bronze Chinese alchemy furnace with three sturdy short feet, two compact curled side handles and a substantial tiered lid slightly lifted. A clean sculpted curl of rising medicinal vapor and one small pill hovering above the lid communicate pill refining; a bright visible warm furnace opening communicates heat. Use a few large forms, readable metal thickness and simple carved bands, rather than elaborate filigree. This should unmistakably be an alchemy furnace, not a cooking pot or a chemistry flask.

A traditional calligraphy brush crosses diagonally in front, with a visible dark brush tip and a strong red painted stroke that visually connects brush and paper. The pattern is purely decorative nonlinguistic geometry: do not write any actual Chinese characters or letters. A few broad dimensional folds make the paper tangible.
